remarks: Live/work in this unique space in the heart of SONO! Experience exquisite features: 20 ft original tin ceilings, Palladian windows, hardwood floors throughout, open kitchen to living space, washer/dryer in unit, elevator in the building, video intercom that rings to your phone will allow you to open the door, keyless entry, on-site superintendent, free storage included in the rent. Walk to train, shopping, restaurants. Parking additional. Good credit is a must.
